name: UCF101
description: An action-recognition dataset of realistic action videos collected from YouTube, covering 101 action categories. This record is metadata-only and does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Soomro, K., Zamir, A. R., & Shah, M. (2012). UCF101: A Dataset of 101 Human Actions Classes From Videos in The Wild. Center for Research in Computer Vision, University of Central Florida. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.1212.0402

license.identifier: Custom UCF101 dataset terms (not a standard SPDX identifier)
